chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-ʿAbbās ibn Maʿrūf and al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Samāʿah ibn Mihrān, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who performed the tawaf of hajj and the tawaf al-nisa' before performing sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah. He said: It does not harm him; he performs sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah, and he has completed his hajj. So this does not contradict the first report, because this report is to be understood as referring to one who did that deliberately.

key_terms.الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ: the two well-known stations between which sa'y is performed in hajj and ʿumrah
key_terms.الْخَبَرَ الْأَوَّلَ: the earlier hadith being compared with this one
key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf connected to the permissibility of marital relations after hajj rites
key_terms.لَا يَضُرُّهُ: it does not invalidate or harm the validity of his rite
key_terms.يَسْعَى: to perform sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone performs Tawaf al-Nisa' before sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the ruling of one who performs Tawaf al-Hajj and Tawaf al-Nisa' before completing the sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah. The Imam عليه السلام states that this does not invalidate the hajj, and the report is reconciled with another narration by interpreting it in light of intentional action.
